name: Procurement Overview

native.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.procurement_requests WHERE status IN ('pending', 'draft')

SELECT date_trunc('month', created_at) as month, SUM(total_amount) as spend FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.procurement_purchase_orders WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'completed', 'approved') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT v.name, SUM(po.total_amount) as total_spend FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.procurement_purchase_orders po JOIN {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.procurement_contracts c ON c.id = po.contract_id JOIN {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.procurement_vendors v ON v.id = c.vendor_id GROUP BY v.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 10
